Subject: Mutual Action Sprint & Exec Liaison — scheduling EB and close milestones

Hi Jules —

Thanks again for the great demo yesterday. We captured a few follow-ups on the evaluation plan and wanted to propose a short mutual-action sprint to land the final confirmation and EB session scheduling so you can make your internal decision on the June 30 close target. High level ask: can you confirm (1) the executive sponsor we should engage for the EB, and (2) three 60‑minute blocks next week that work for the EB attendees (senior exec + procurement + technical reviewer)?

Draft MAP (attached) assumes a 2-week evaluation window with a final EB meeting on our end to present performance, security posture, and rollout options. If you prefer a different cadence we can adapt, but we need final sponsor alignment by end of next week to hold the proposed EB slots.

Proposed next steps:
- Jules: confirm exec sponsor and procurement contact
- Acme: pick one preferred EB slot from the attached ICS list
- Redwood: finalize MAP_v1 and populate responsibilities (owner + due date)

Ben — can you lead the EB presentation and own the demo script? Marissa — please prepare the MAP owner table so we can drop Acme names in once we hear back.

Thanks,
Aisha

--
